svg.text: Supplementary Figure S2. Multi-gene benchmark panel: nominal significance across analysis frameworks
GSE91061, Mann-Whitney P by framework. Red = more significant; 10 established ICB markers + ZP3* (candidate).
Across framework B alone, 7/10 established markers reached nominal significance; at baseline (A) only CTLA4 did, and no gene remained
significant at the patient-aggregated level (C). The candidate row (ZP3*) reproduced the frozen main-analysis P values exactly
(0.352 / 0.008 / 0.175). Significance gained under naive pooling is not reproduced when repeated measurements are aggregated per patient.
